displayName: SentinelGraph {{SERVICE}}: actions not delivered to the bank

documentation.content:
In assist mode an approved or automatic action could not be delivered to ACTION_WEBHOOK_URL after three tries. **The action has not happened.**

1. Agent Activity > Health lists the event ids.
2. Check the receiving system and the shared secret.
3. Carry out urgent actions (card blocks) by hand; the audit log has the details.

Console: {{CONSOLE_URL}} · Logs: Cloud Logging, filter `jsonPayload.event="action_send_failed"` on services `{{SERVICE}}*`.
